# v0.10.3 · 存储空间管理与目录生成优化 / Storage Management and Outline Generation Improvements

## 中文

### 存储空间管理

- 在“设置 → 通用”新增存储空间管理，分类查看历史残留、页面缓存、开发日志以及保留数据的占用。
- 支持清理数据库中已无引用的知识库文档、资信库图片，以及页面缓存和开发日志；保留有效业务资料、配置与数据库。
- 清理时检查后台任务，运行中的相关清理项会跳过，并显示释放空间、跳过和失败情况。

### 技术方案与已有方案扩写

- 按当前生成方式检查目录生成依据：自由生成支持仅有技术要求的资料；按评分项对齐需要评分依据，按响应文件目录需要明确的响应文件技术目录。
- 缺少对应依据时，在生成配置弹窗显示具体原因并禁用“开始生成”；后台同步校验，避免无效任务清空已有结果。响应文件目录模式不再自动回退为评分项对齐。
- 收紧技术评分内容提取规则，避免将普通技术参数、技术要求当作评分项。
- 人员配置优先使用岗位、人数与职责描述，移除虚构姓名示例，并约束全局事实与正文生成不得杜撰姓名。

### 界面改进

- 收紧正文生成等待动画与进度条的间距，减少多余滚动。
- 修复扩写改写步骤章节预览中表头背景与主题不匹配的问题。
- 优化启象设置操作行、目录生成弹窗的提示位置与分区背景；为暗标检查提供独立的匿名审查图标。

## English

### Storage management

- Added storage management under Settings → General, with usage grouped into leftover files, page caches, developer logs, and retained data.
- Added cleanup for knowledge-base documents and credential-library images no longer referenced by the database, plus page caches and developer logs. Active business files, configuration, and databases are retained.
- Cleanup checks background tasks, skips affected items while tasks are running, and reports freed space, skipped items, and failures.

### Technical plans and existing-plan expansion

- Validate prerequisites for the selected outline mode: Free generation supports technical requirements alone; score-aligned generation requires scoring criteria; response-document generation requires an explicit technical document outline.
- Show a specific explanation and disable Start Generation when the selected mode lacks its required source material. Backend validation also prevents invalid tasks from clearing existing results. Response-document mode no longer silently falls back to score alignment.
- Tightened scoring extraction rules to avoid treating ordinary technical parameters and requirements as scoring items.
- Describe staffing by role, headcount, and responsibilities; removed fictional-name examples and instructed global-fact and body generation not to invent names.

### Interface improvements

- Reduced spacing around the writing wait animation and progress bar to avoid unnecessary scrolling.
- Fixed theme-mismatched table headers in chapter previews during expansion and rewriting.
- Refined Modern settings action rows, outline-dialog notices, and section backgrounds; added a distinct anonymous-review icon for blind bid checks.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.10.2...v0.10.3
